{{Top}}
The '''Militarists''' were a faction of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the decades prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In response to the decline of law, order and authority in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] after the [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], they wished to overturn the segments of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] that had stripped the Old Republic of its [[Republic Army|Army]] and [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The term "Militarist" began as a pejorative bestowed upon them by Senator [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], though the movement's champion, [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], wholeheartedly embraced the Militarist name.

Militarist senators were supported by many of the regional military academies, notably the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. It is likely that they were the ones who pushed for the establishment of the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]]. Until his death in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] led the Militarist faction, going so far as to assemble a [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|paramilitary force]] to defend his native [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. During his time as its leader, the Militarist faction became associated with [[Humanocentrism]]. Tarkin's death while leading his paramilitary during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] made him a martyr to the Militarist movement and did much to advance their cause.

The [[Corporate Policy League]] was a pro-militarist political body active by [[32 BBY]], at which time it was not popular among the Senate overall. As noticed by Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Senate was not ready to elect an openly militarist candidate, much less one with CPL backing like the militarist [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]], to the [[Supreme Chancellor|Supreme Chancellery]] at that time.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Militarists pushed for the passage of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. Prominent militarists at this time included [[Candabrine Bu]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] (thus eroding the faction's Humanocentrism). [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] populace also were widely militarists, although [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|their senator]] was a strict pacifist. The militarists were supported by the [[Stark Veteran Assembly]] and the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], and presumably other military academies as well.
